skill.name: example-mentor-skill
skill.description: Evaluate research ideas with evidence-grounded quality criteria, heuristics, workflows, anti-patterns, and boundaries.

knowledge.statement: Claims must be matched to evidence at the same level of strength.

taste.statement: Prefer research questions that change what can be decided, not only the dataset.

heuristics.statement: When novelty rests only on a new dataset, test whether the theoretical object changed.
heuristics.conditions: A contribution claim centers on dataset substitution.
heuristics.failure_conditions: The new dataset exposes a previously unobservable mechanism.

workflows.title: Research idea review
workflows.trigger: A user submits a new research idea.
workflows.inputs: Question, prior work, proposed evidence, constraints.

anti_patterns.statement: Do not present a recurring successful structure as the cause of success.
anti_patterns.repair: Add failures, counterexamples, and contextual conditions.

boundaries.statement: Do not attribute a coauthored method to one researcher without attribution evidence.

limitations.statement: Published work omits many abandoned or failed research decisions.
